preconditions.description: The input string s consists of lowercase Latin letters and has length between 1 and 1000 (inclusive).

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz' for c in stdin.strip())
preconditions.description: All characters in the input string s are lowercase Latin letters.

postconditions.description: If no valid permutation exists, output is exactly 'NO'. Otherwise, output is 'YES' followed by a valid permutation on the next line.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().splitlines()[0] == 'YES' implies (lambda s: all(any(s[p*i-1] == s[p*j-1] for j in range(1, len(s)//p + 1)) for p in primes_up_to(len(s))))(stdout.strip().splitlines()[1])
postconditions.description: If the answer is 'YES', the permutation s' satisfies: for every prime p ≤ |s| and every integer i from 1 to |s|/p, the character at position p*i in s' equals the character at position p in s'. Here, primes_up_to(n) is the list of primes ≤ n.

postconditions.expression: stdout.strip().splitlines()[0] == 'YES' implies (lambda s: all(c in s for c in stdin.strip()))(stdout.strip().splitlines()[1])
postconditions.description: If the answer is 'YES', the permutation uses exactly the same multiset of characters as the input string.
